claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
NASA's Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed mission.
NASA's Artemis II mission will send four astronauts around the Moon and back.
NASA's Artemis II mission marks the first human journey to deep space in over 50 years.
The launch vehicle for NASA's Artemis II mission is the Space Launch System (SLS) Rocket.
The spacecraft for NASA's Artemis II mission is the Orion Capsule.
The crew of NASA's Artemis II mission is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
The mission goal of NASA's Artemis II mission is to test human capabilities for lunar exploration.
NASA's Artemis II mission is currently in its final pre-launch phase.
NASA's Artemis II mission moved to Launch Pad 39B in late March 2026.
